input.body:
label: bug
file: src/notifications/templates.ts

The issue is caused by the BASE_URL constant in src/notifications/templates.ts, which is used to build the password reset link in the email. It currently falls back to "http://localhost:3000" if the environment variable PUBLIC_URL is not set:

```ts
const BASE_URL = process.env.PUBLIC_URL ?? "http://localhost:3000";
```

If PUBLIC_URL is not configured in the environment where the email sending happens, the password reset links will incorrectly point to localhost.

To fix this, you need to ensure that the PUBLIC_URL environment variable is correctly set to your deployed frontend's external URL (e.g., https://ledgerline.app) in the production environment or wherever the email service is running. Without this, the reset password links will default to localhost.

There is no code logic error; the problem is the missing or incorrect environment configuration for PUBLIC_URL.
